title: Bug: DayBar data replaced after laptop restart (Halo/Mandi/Test)
description: After laptop restart, persisted DayBar data disappeared and was replaced by carried-over tasks Halo, Mandi, Test (~20d aging). Investigate persistence/store path, seed data, Reminders sync, and recent commits.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified with evidence; data loss path explained; fix or recovery path documented
notes: Fixed via daybar-6ug: store pinned under Application Support/DayBar/daybar.store; legacy JSON renamed after settle; Reminders auth published on AppState; new habits default remindersSyncEnabled from global pref.
close_reason: Root cause fixed: pinned store + neutralize legacy JSON; see daybar-6ug

description: Carried-over complete, skipped habit incomplete, habit notify/sync, analytics avg/day, Swift 6

title: Resize panel height when task/habit counts change
description: Panel height is only set in showPanel(). Adding a task while open forces scroll until remount. Make height dynamic (observe counts) with existing max (80% screen).
close_reason: While panel is visible, observe habit/today/tomorrow/carried counts via withObservationTracking and snap-resize with desiredPanelHeight()+positionPanel(). Build succeeded.

title: Show caret/focus affordance on quick-add field
description: When clicking Add a task for today, no visible typing caret so user can't tell if field is focused. Fix focus visibility.
notes: Root cause: plain TextField has no focus chrome; borderless nonactivating NSPanel often fails to draw AppKit insertion point even when FocusState is true. Fix: focus ring affordance + make panel key on focus.
close_reason: Added focus chrome + blinking caret for empty quick-add; panel makeKey on mouseDown and becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded=false so AppKit focus/caret work in nonactivating panel.

title: Fix mood AI constrained tagging (stop false Neutral)
description: Use @Generable enum / anyOf so Foundation Models cannot return invalid tags that coerce to neutral; improve multilingual instructions.
close_reason: Constrained Generable mood enum + multilingual instructions + fromAITag mapping. Tests green.

title: Fix backlog nudge timing + notification presentation
description: Once/day 14:00 backlog; suppress banner when panel open; quiet hours sound; threadIdentifiers.
close_reason: Backlog once/day at next 14:00; willPresent suppress when panel open; quiet-hours sound; thread IDs. Tests green.
